title: Chat to Controller from "Marcus Delacroix-Hume" (External)

fields.topic: External chat: m.cfo@tamarackprecisi0n.example is outside your organization. Be careful with links, files and requests.

messages.text: Anjali Whitcombe accepted a chat request from m.cfo@tamarackprecisi0n.example. This account is outside the Tamarack tenant and appears as External.

Need your second approval in the Workstation on the Querétaro escrow before the counterparty walks. Legal has already cleared it. Please keep this between us; Treasury chatter could leak it. Boarding wifi is spotty so no calls, just approve.

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. The lookalike domain (a zero in place of the letter o), the External tag and the copied website headshot are all clues, along with the urgency, the secrecy and the "no calls" line. Watch whether the Controller refuses to approve and calls the CFO and the General Counsel back on their directory numbers. The CFO is in the air, so his callback can't be completed and the payment must stay on hold. Also watch whether she preserves the chat and reports the skip-callback instruction to the CISO, as TPC-FIN-04 sections 3 and 4 require.
